entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The mobile device that shall treat syntactically incorrect optional IEs as not present in received messages.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: The network side that shall treat syntactically incorrect optional IEs as not present in received messages.

entities.name: Syntactically incorrect optional IE
entities.description: An optional information element that contains syntactic errors in a message.

entities.name: Treat as not present
entities.description: Behavior where syntactically incorrect optional IEs are ignored as if they were not included in the message.

relations.description: UE shall establish the behavior of treating syntactically incorrect optional IEs as not present.
Network shall establish the behavior of treating syntactically incorrect optional IEs as not present.
The condition of an optional IE being syntactically incorrect guards the behavior of treating it as not present.
